pages.title: Mounting and power
pages.text: The Wafer Guard connects a completed circuit to redstone inputs and outputs in the world. It can operate outside a cleanroom but still needs power.$(br2)Right-click with a wafer to mount it. Right-click with an empty hand to read stored energy and the mounted wafer's per-tick cost.

pages.title: Signal connections
pages.text: Connect input signals and output wiring in the directions configured in the circuit. Output pins drive adjacent redstone devices.$(br2)Use a $(l:siliconic:redstone_clock)redstone clock$(/l) as an input when needed. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to retrieve the wafer.
